results.section: 安全及品質監控 SAFETY AND QUALITY MONITORING
results.text: We have a technical system in place to provide the appropriate 'quality control indicators' for each product to undergo finished product testing. In the event that there is a significant problem with product quality that requires a recall, the director of the Quality Assurance Department shall follow the established product recall guidelines to initiate the procedures while informing the management of the product recall. Necessary corrective and preventive measures should be taken to prevent the recurrence of similar events. During the year under review, the coatings and inks businesses had no product recalls due to problems associated with product safety.
